title: Iron Key D-9
hook: On a lonely night watch at a remote coastal cable station, a guard finds a steaming hot meal waiting for him inside a locked, empty facility.

title: The Brass Threshold
hook: Pushed to the brink of collapse by chronic exhaustion, a hospice nurse tending a dying patient inside a rural mortuary notices the quiet rooms subtly shifting around her.

title: Caretaker's Quarters
hook: During a routine winter inspection of an abandoned mining camp, an inspector discovers impossible traces of himself inside the silent caretaker’s cabin.

title: Cellblock 2
hook: While surveying pipes inside a condemned prison before nighttime lockdown, an inspector discovers a powered terminal running an active evaluation inside an abandoned security booth.

title: Shoal Light No. 4
hook: A traveling veterinarian arrives at an isolated offshore lighthouse to treat an injured cat, but as the fog rolls in, he uncovers an impossible secret inside the keeper's quarters.

title: Patient 143
hook: During an eerie graveyard shift in a clinical sleep unit, a technician monitoring an unresponsive patient notices an uninvited warmth bleeding from a cracked supply closet door.

title: The Secondary Crossing
hook: Detouring to escape her mother’s funeral procession, a woman pulls into a neglected rural checkpoint and is directed into a chilling inspection bay of silent, stoic drivers.

title: Burnt Taste Motel
hook: As she unfolds the receipt, a chill runs down her spine as she recognizes her own handwriting in the cryptic notes scrawled on its back.

title: Seed Vault Secrecy
hook: As Cyrus continues to review the seed counts, a sudden chill runs down his spine, and he feels like something is watching him from the shadows.

title: Station 34 Watch
hook: As he scans the horizon, Franklin Ohara's unease grows, his senses heightened by the eerie silence that has descended over Station 34.
